reference: Two halves. NUMERIC: the live calculation behind the questionnaire is graded against an independent implementation of the ASHRAE Handbook Fundamentals (2017) chapter 1 psychrometric formulation and closed-form energy and mass balances (bench-src/ref/lgs_model.py), and cross-checked against CoolProp 8.0 HAPropsSI (ASHRAE RP-1485 real-fluid humid air); the ASHRAE formulation is the grading reference because it is the one the tool states it implements, and the deviation of the real-fluid model from it is reported as the inherent uncertainty of that choice, never as a tool error. DATA INTEGRITY (this half is not a physics benchmark and is not presented as one): the schema of every question, profile and rule, the absence of any answer key the code reads but the sheet cannot set, and the completeness of the five lazily loaded language packs against the inline Dutch base.
reference_citations: ASHRAE Handbook - Fundamentals (2017), chapter 1 "Psychrometrics": saturation pressure eq. (5) over ice and eq. (6) over liquid water, humidity ratio eq. (20), specific volume eq. (26), enthalpy eq. (30) h = 1.006 t + W(2501 + 1.86 t), thermodynamic wet-bulb eq. (33), standard atmosphere eq. (3).
CoolProp 8.0.0, HAPropsSI humid-air property routines implementing ASHRAE RP-1485 (Herrmann, Kretzschmar & Gatley), used as the second, structurally different reference.

Closed-form balances written independently for this benchmark: dry-air mass flow m = V/v, coil duty Q = m (h_in - h_out), sensible duty Q_s = m (c_pa + c_pv W)(t_in - t_out), condensate = m (W_in - W_out), fan power P = V dp / eta, SFP = P/V.

Commission Regulation (EU) No 1253/2014 (Ecodesign for ventilation units), 2018 tier: the minimum thermal efficiency values the tool holds for regenerative (73 %) and recuperative (68 %) heat recovery.
tolerance: NUMERIC half: 2e-6 relative on every psychrometric and thermal quantity. The tool and the reference evaluate the same closed-form ASHRAE equations, so anything above double-precision round-off is a real disagreement; air flows are rounded to whole m3/h by the tool and are compared with an absolute tolerance of 0.5 m3/h for that reason, and the identities that define fan power and SFP are checked at 1e-9. The CoolProp crosscheck is reported, never used to grade: the constant-cp formulation the tool declares differs from the RP-1485 real-fluid model by up to 0.5 % in humidity ratio, 1.3 kJ/kg in enthalpy, 0.09 % in specific volume, 0.011 K in dew point, 0.082 K in wet-bulb temperature and 3 % in cooling duty over the benchmark grid, and that spread is the inherent uncertainty of the declared model rather than an error in it. DATA-INTEGRITY half: exact set equality and zero schema errors, no tolerance at all.
crosscheck: ASHRAE constant-cp formulation vs CoolProp RP-1485 over the 28-point grid: humidity ratio 0.50 %, enthalpy 1.25 kJ/kg, specific volume 0.090 %, dew point 0.011 K, wet bulb 0.082 K, saturation pressure 0.49 %.
not_benchmarked: the indicative component data itself — module pressure drops, casing lengths, masses and default recovery efficiencies are single catalogue values per component type and the tool says so; what is checked is that they are applied consistently, not that they match any particular product
the coil as a heat exchanger: the tool computes an enthalpy balance with the leaving state clipped to a fixed apparatus-line humidity and explicitly does not model NTU or coil rows
the annual energy figure beyond its own arithmetic: it is a degree-day estimate at design duty and is declared as indicative
acoustics — the tool performs no acoustic calculation at all and says so

flagged.reason: model difference between the two independent references, not a tool defect
flagged.detail: The tool declares the ASHRAE Fundamentals constant-cp psychrometric formulation. Against CoolProp 8.0 (ASHRAE RP-1485 real fluid) that formulation differs by up to 0.50 % in humidity ratio, 1.25 kJ/kg in enthalpy, 0.090 % in specific volume, 0.011 K in dew point and 0.082 K in wet-bulb temperature over the benchmark grid, and by up to 3.03 % in coil duty. The tool is graded against the formulation it states it implements; this figure is the inherent uncertainty of that choice.

cases.note: DATA INTEGRITY. Every question has a type, unique id and — where it is a choice — a non-empty set of distinct options; every application profile presets only real questions with values that are real options and names the basis of its defaults; and every answer key the calculation reads is either a question of the sheet or is declared in ADVANCED_KEYS as one that can only arrive with an imported project file or a handoff
notes: answer keys with no question, all declared in ADVANCED_KEYS with a stated fallback: air_w_leave_override, cas_face_ratio, com_hours, flw_volume
